subject: USAGE POINTER clause (alignment, size, representation, and range of values)
notes: kb/Work PB970 arm 2 + PB465. docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 row DOC-A.1-216 carries the determination for all four things 13.18.60.4 GR23 leaves to the implementor: alignment (a reference's 8-byte natural alignment), size (8, FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH), range (signed 64-bit displacements, PB465) and - landed here - the REPRESENTATION of the 8 storage positions, chosen by CLAUDE.md rule 1's ISO -> GnuCOBOL -> IBM/Micro Focus precedence: GnuCOBOL's machine address in the native binary byte order, NULL = zero address; this implementation's address token in its own binary order (big-endian, A.1 items 205/207): NULL eight X'00', a data-pointer = area base (k * 2^32) + displacement, program/function-pointers a per-(category, name) base. ONE codec (PointerImage) serves the CALL boundary's BY CONTENT record. RESIDUE (lead, not claimed here): a byte VIEW of a shared area's pointer member (a BASED window) still reads the PB231 reserved spaces, not the image - pinned by conformance:cases/14.9.3-ALLOCATE/pb231_based_pointer_leaf; making the area's bytes carry the image needs a NULL-image seed at every cell creation (ALLOCATE fill, the group-image composer) plus a slot-write shadow, and is recorded as a lead for an owner-visible decision.
